singleSourced.context: There had been some concern over whether audiences would show up for the new live action Street Fighter movie, but it managed to top the worldwide box office this weekend with a $51.1 million international haul.

While optimists had been hoping for a number closer to $70 million, unless ticket sales fall off a cliff over the coming weeks, this is a decent result for the film, which was made on an $82 million budget, according to Deadline.

Deadline reports that Street Fighter, an adaptation of Capcom's series of fighting games, grossed $31 million its opening weekend.
By comparison, the Capcom horror game adaptation Resident Evil made $60 million its opening weekend and is still charting at the box office about a month after release.
The real overperformer of the weekend was the Elizabeth Holmes documentary You Can See Everything, which had the second-biggest opening for a theatrically released documentary ever at $15 million.
